description.value: Pita Pit is a healthy fast-food chain located inside Orchard Park Mall on Harvey Avenue in Kelowna, offering build-your-own pitas, salads, rice bowls, and smoothies. It operates as a takeout and delivery location with no drive-through. Touring cyclists passing through Kelowna's main commercial corridor will find it a quick, customizable stop for a filling meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this location is operational at 2271 Harvey Ave Unit 440, Kelowna, BC with matching phone and address. The OSM tag takeaway=yes and website 'Order Takeout/Delivery' confirm takeout. No evidence found for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities. The URL slug contains 'coming-soon' but the page content shows a fully live listing — flagged as a concern.
concerns: The OSM website URL slug contains 'coming-soon' (https://pitapit.ca/restaurants/kelowna-harvey-ave-coming-soon/), suggesting the OSM record may have been created before the location opened and the URL was never updated. The page content now shows a fully operational location, so no action is needed beyond noting the stale URL slug.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food location confirmed by website content with matching address and phone. Useful to touring cyclists on the Harvey Avenue corridor.
